n: Argon is the name Google gave the Gemini 4 model it opened to developers on Oct. 13. Two lines in the post matter for your work: one limit of a million tokens shared between what you send and what comes back, and a launch price that doubles after Nov. 30. When a tool gets a new engine, read the price page before you build a routine on it.
